subject: [hw] R1: V16 accepted (3284938/3284938, 23/23 independent forms)
body: Reviewed DONE V16: emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V16 PASS 3284938/3284938 on my run, and my 23 independent T32 forms all pass: ldr.w/str.w/ldrb.w/strh.w/ldrsb.w/ldrsh.w imm12, ldr.w literal, register offset, post/pre-index, imm8 negative, ldm.w/stmdb.w, ldrd/strd, ldrex/strex, tbb/tbh, mrs/msr APSR, nop.w/dmb/dsb/isb, mrc p15 tpidruro. F9 and F13 are fixed and closed. I also read n2a32_t32_misc.c: the 21/25-bit branch immediates, BL/BLX LR and Align(PC,4) target, hints/barriers, UDF and the one cp15 read match the ARM ARM. V16 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
